newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's end-Aug palm oil stock 800,893 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's end-Aug palm oil stock 800,893 tonnes.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks rose 5.99 percent to 800,893 tonnes at end-August from 755,665 at end-July and compared with 573,956 tonnes at end-August 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Monday.

Stocks of crude palm oil were 472,200 tonnes, against 402,659 at end-July and 288,736 a year earlier. Processed palm oil stocks totalled 328,693 tonnes compared with 353,006 and 285,220 respectively, PORLA said.

Stocks of crude palm kernel oil were 53,353 tonnes at end-August against 50,357 at end-July and 42,344 at end-August 1995. Processed palm kernel oil stocks were 48,557 tonnes compared with 49,223 and 42,382 respectively.
